MemoryPort — concept for user workspace read/write.

Implementations: MdFileAdapter (F1), PostgresMemoryAdapter (F6). Paddock layout: {paddocksDir}/{uuid}/ USER.md — identity, preferences summary PREFERENCES.md — provider, language, timezone MEMORY.md — episodic/semantic notes updated per session CONTACTS.md — known people SOLUTIONS.md — reusable solutions sessions/ — per-session conversation logs

Imports

../core/types, ../domain/message, ../domain/personality

Types

MemoryHit = object
  content*: string
  score*: float32            ## cosine similarity [0, 1]; higher = more similar
  kind*: string              ## node kind: "memory", "fact", "user_profile", etc.
Single result from a semantic search. Source   Edit   
MemoryPort = concept m
    m.hasProfile(UserId) is bool
    m.loadContext(UserId) is UserContext
    ## Loads USER.md + MEMORY.md + PREFERENCES.md into a UserContext.
    m.saveUserMd(UserId, string)
    ## Overwrites USER.md (or equivalent) for the given user.
    m.appendMemory(UserId, string)
    ## Appends a block of text to MEMORY.md (creates if absent).
    m.savePreferences(UserId, string)
    ## Overwrites PREFERENCES.md.
Returns true iff USER.md (or equivalent) exists for this user. Source   Edit
